job.title: People & Culture Manager - Part-Time
job.description:
Connected People is proud to be partnering with Prelude Australia to recruit an experienced People & Culture Manager.

Prelude Australia is a not-for-profit organisation that has supported children and families for more than 40 years. Today, its highly qualified team provides best-practice early childhood and therapy supports for children from birth to twelve, including children with developmental delay and disability. Their purpose is simple but powerful: to support a positive future for all children.

The Opportunity
This is a senior, broad generalist P&C role offering approximately a 50/50 balance between strategic and operational work.

Sitting on the Executive Leadership Team, you will take genuine ownership of the people function within an organisation of approximately 37 employees. With no direct reports, this is an opportunity for someone who enjoys having autonomy, influencing at a senior level and still being hands-on when required.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Providing strategic P&C advice to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.
  • Preparing for and leading the upcoming Enterprise Agreement bargaining process.
  • Managing ER/IR matters.
  • Leading workforce planning, organisational change and capability initiatives.
  • Strengthening Prelude Australia's approach to psychosocial risk, wellbeing and workplace compliance.
  • Coaching leaders to build their people management capability.
  • Driving proactive culture, engagement and recognition initiatives.
  • Managing HR systems, policies, processes and legislative compliance.
  • Developing strategic recruitment and long-term talent pipelines, including relationships with universities and allied health scholarship recipients.
About You
Prelude Australia is looking for someone who combines warmth, capability and proactivity.

You will be an experienced P&C leader who can confidently navigate complex people matters and advise at Executive level, while remaining approachable and connected to employees.

You will bring:
  • Previous experience as a HR Manager, People & Culture Manager or equivalent Manager-level position.
  • A relevant tertiary qualification.
  • Previous Enterprise Agreement bargaining experience desirable but not essential.
  • Strong generalist ER/IR capability.
  • Experience within a not-for-profit or closely aligned purpose-driven environment such as disability, community services, health or education.
  • The ability to operate strategically while remaining comfortable with hands-on HR delivery.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • A proactive, autonomous approach and the confidence to identify what needs to be done and make it happen.
Experience in psychosocial risk, workforce planning, organisational change and strategic talent pipelines will be highly regarded.

Genuine Flexibility:
This is a rare opportunity to secure a senior P&C position at 22.8 hours per week, with opportunities to self-manage work hours flexibly across the day/fortnight, plus additional breaks to support work-life balance.

Prelude Australia is open to three full days or shorter hours across four or five days, including school-hours arrangements where workable. Ideally, hours will be spread across the week to provide greater access to P&C support.

The role will have a regular presence across Prelude Australia's Maitland, Kurri Kurri and Singleton locations, combined with some work-from-home flexibility.

What's On Offer?
  • $68.31 per hour + superannuation
  • Not-for-profit salary packaging
  • Professional development allowance
  • An additional two weeks of leave per year
  • Opportunity for an additional one week of unpaid leave in January 
  • Genuine flexibility around family and personal commitments
  • Executive Leadership Team position
  • The autonomy to shape and lead the P&C function
  • The opportunity to make a visible impact within a genuinely purpose-led organisation.
Interested?
Connected People is managing this recruitment process on behalf of Prelude Australia.

job.title: Senior Administrator - Real Estate
job.description:
Great opportunity in Newcastle’s CBD to join a  leading independent real estate agency as an experienced administrator to take ownership of the sales process from the moment a property is listed through to settlement.

This is the role that holds everything together. You'll be the person who knows where every file sits, what's outstanding, and what happens next, keeping agents, vendors, purchasers, solicitors and third parties moving in the same direction. It suits someone who takes genuine satisfaction in a well-run process and who would rather prevent a problem than fix one.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll have the support of an experienced remote professional and an onshore Operations Manager, so your focus can stay on judgement, oversight and the parts of the process that need a senior head.

What you'll be doing

  • Managing the end-to-end sales administration process from listing through to settlement
  • Preparing and processing listing documentation, agency agreements and sales advices
  • Liaising with vendors, purchasers, solicitors, conveyancers and other agencies to keep transactions on track
  • Tracking cooling-off periods, deposits, conditions and settlement dates, and following up anything outstanding
  • Coordinating agent marketing inc campaign bookings, copy, photography, signage and portal listings
  • Coordinating in-house promotion and brand activity
  • Maintaining accurate records in the CRM and ensuring compliance obligations are met
  • Delegating to and reviewing the work of the remote support role, and working alongside the Operations Manager on process improvement
  
Ideal Experience required

  • Ideally solid experience in real estate administration, ideally across the listing-to-settlement process, OR from closely related industries such as conveyancing, legal, property management, finance, insurance or settlements; who have strong crossover skills and want to move into real estate.
  • Strong organisational skills and genuine attention to detail — you notice the thing that's missing
  • Confident communication with clients and third parties, including when a deal is under pressure
  • Comfort managing several transactions at different stages at once
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership, while supporting a small team
  • Great verbal & written communication skills
  • The ability to work in the agency office full time – Newcastle CBD
Also useful, but not essential

  • Basic trust accounting experience
  • Experience with real estate CRM and marketing platforms
  • A NSW Certificate of Registration or Real Estate Licence
  
What’s on offer

  • A defined, senior role with real ownership of the process
  • Genuine support: an experienced remote professional and an onshore Operations Manager
  • Stable, sociable hours & no weekend work
  • A collaborative team environment in the Newcastle property industry
  • A business environment where growth is encouraged, and progression is a genuine opportunity
